agent_explanation: Raw controller force is ~kp*velocity-error (~19.86*~33 ~= 666 N), far above fmax 19.2. Steps 51-52 report force exactly at fmax, so clamping works, but at step 53 the raw value 666.56 is reported unclamped. Likely cause: force-limit clamp is bypassed on the substepped/control-update path taken at step 53 (23 substeps, high speed ~35 approaching waypoint), emitting the raw proportional force instead of min(raw,fmax).
